svg.title: From Entered Judgment to Earned Service Fee
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-commercial-judgment-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Entered Judgment to Earned Service Fee; subtitle: Five controlled handoffs separate enforcement authority from collected cash.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Designed for commercial post-judgment recovery. State procedure, licensing, representation requirements, and the service agreement determine permitted activity. Assignment does not automatically authorize a nonlawyer to represent another party.; caption: Court deadlines and payment reconciliation can be automated; legal conclusions and enforcement selections remain assigned to qualified people.; stages: label: Screen the docket; value: Confirm entry, parties, balance, age, and enforceability before outreach; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use PACER for federal matters and the relevant state court portal for state judgments. Obtain the judgment and subsequent orders; record appeals, stays, service issues, payments, and renewal deadlines with source-document links.; label: Establish lawful authority; value: Document creditor instructions, assignment scope, and counsel responsibilities; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify the creditor and any assignment chain. Execute a service agreement defining fees, expense responsibility, remittance timing, and termination. Confirm required licenses and use counsel for reserved legal work.; label: Map reachable equity; value: Identify assets, competing liens, exemptions, and current bankruptcy exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Search authorized court, recorder, and Secretary of State records. Distinguish ownership from possession, subtract senior claims, and record data provenance. Do not purchase a consumer report without a documented permissible purpose.; label: Select the recovery route; value: Compare voluntary payment against counsel-directed execution costs and timing; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Prepare an asset-specific cost estimate and settlement authority limits. Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 69 generally uses state execution procedure. Calendar each required notice, writ, service event, and response deadline.; label: Reconcile and remit; value: Allocate cleared receipts, earned fees, expenses, and creditor remittances; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match bank transactions to the matter ledger, investigate returns, and follow applicable client-fund handling rules. Recognize only earned operator service fees as revenue; track satisfaction filings and remaining balances.
